name: hypeproof-chat
description: Built-in chat panel for HypeProof Studio.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The coach can run shell commands and resolve an SDK executable. In an untrusted workspace, the runtime/executable and gateway settings are ignored and every action still passes through the approval gate.

hypeproofChat.proxyUrl.description: Base URL for the HypeProof Proxy (OpenAI-compatible). Override for local dev (e.g. http://localhost:8787/v1). Machine-scoped: a workspace cannot repoint the coach at an untrusted gateway.

hypeproofChat.freeStart.description: Free start (no code on first open). "service": follow what the Service advertises at /v1/trial/offer (entry "open" with a claim route). "off": always show the code-based start page.

hypeproofChat.model.description: Requested model alias. The Service resolves it using the cohort policy. The Agent SDK route also permits the fast model; other unrecognized values use the default.

hypeproofChat.coachRuntime.description: Coach runtime. 'proxy' = the current single-turn provider proxy (default). 'agent-sdk' = the Claude Agent SDK coach (epic #282). Until the SDK is bundled (Phase 1), selecting 'agent-sdk' transparently falls back to the proxy runtime for each turn (a dev warning is logged); it never interrupts the student. Machine-scoped: a workspace cannot flip the runtime to the SDK executable path.

hypeproofChat.sdkBinaryPath.description: Absolute path to a claude CLI binary for the agent-sdk coach runtime (epic #282). Highest-priority override; when empty, resolution falls through HPS_SDK_BINARY (env) → the seeded per-user location (scripts/seed-sdk-binary.sh) → node_modules (dev). If nothing resolves, the coach falls back to the proxy runtime. Machine-scoped: this selects an executable, so a workspace must not be able to set it.

hypeproofChat.sdkSeedOnDemand.description: studio-sdk-seed-on-demand (REQ-M46). When no claude CLI binary resolves before an agent-sdk turn, ask the user to download the native SDK seed from this App's own public release into the seeded per-user location; it is installed only if its sha256 matches the release and its sha512 matches the value pinned in this App. Default off. Machine-scoped: it fetches an executable, so a workspace must not be able to turn it on.

hypeproofChat.sdkStallTimeoutMs.description: How long (ms) the agent-sdk coach may go without progress before the turn is aborted with a friendly retry message (#403). Guards the cases the 401/400 fast-fail does not cover — gateway 429/529/5xx retry storms, or a first turn that never produces a token — which otherwise leave the student on "생각하는 중…" forever. 0 disables the watchdog.

hypeproofChat.requireApprovalFor.description: Actions that require explicit user approval before execution. 이 배열이 승인 정책의 단일 소스다 — 코드의 getConfiguration 폴백은 매니페스트 default 가 있는 한 절대 쓰이지 않는다(#499). writeFile 은 기본에서 제외(#464): 워크스페이스 밖 경로는 모달 없이 이미 거부되고, 실측에서 이 모달이 세션을 멈추거나 반사 승인을 훈련시켰다. 되돌리려면 "writeFile" 을 추가한다. consultHelper (the coach consulting a roster helper, ADR 0011) is offered but not in the default: helpers have no tools, see only declared workspace excerpts, and appear in the timeline. Add "consultHelper" to require a modal. Machine-scoped: a workspace cannot weaken the approval gate (e.g. clear it to auto-run shell/file writes).

hypeproofChat.siteBase.description: HypeProof Lab 사이트 주소. '갤러리에 올리기'가 여기로 보냅니다. 로컬 개발 서버에 붙여 볼 때만 바꾸세요 (예: http://localhost:3000). 아이 작품이 실제로 올라가는 목적지이므로 워크스페이스 설정이 아니라 머신 설정입니다 — proxyUrl 과 같은 범위입니다 (#748).

hypeproofChat.accountsEnabled.description: Enable personal accounts (Google sign-in at purchase). Takes effect only on the canonical HypeProof HTTPS Service and account site; any other Service or site has no accounts. Local preview is a separate setting.

hypeproofChat.publicUpdates.description: Without member access to the private release mirror, check for updates against the public HypeProof Studio release that the Lab download serves (read anonymously). Members are unchanged. Off by default.

hypeproofChat.accountsPreview.description: Enable the isolated personal account preview. Both proxyUrl and siteBase must point to loopback HTTP servers. Production account launch remains disabled.
